reports.title: Shattered Street Lamp Fixture
reports.figureCaption: Street lamp casing completely shattered, bulb exposed to weather
reports.description: The lamp cover on the streetlight at Junction L-04 is completely shattered. The bare bulb and wiring are exposed to rain, creating both a safety and electrical hazard for passing pedestrians at night.

routeImpact.recommendation: Avoid night jogging along boulevard or take well-lit inner walkway.

resident.warningText: Dim section with exposed broken glass and bulb near Central Boulevard.
resident.actionNeeded: Use illuminated side corridor or travel in groups.

security.patrolAlert: Electrical short hazard if wet weather persists. Priority checkpoint L-04.

property.contractorTask: Replace casing and install energy-efficient LED luminaire.

reports.title: Damaged Lamp Post & Flickering Luminaire
reports.locationName: Central Transit Hub Approach (L-08 / Courtyard North)
reports.figureCaption: Bent housing bracket with intermittently flickering LED pole head
reports.description: Street lamp pole head fixture exhibiting loose wiring and rapid strobing/flickering. Significantly degrades night-time visibility for commuters walking toward transit stop.

routeImpact.recommendation: Maintain transit pathway lighting through solar backup lamps.

resident.warningText: Flickering light causing disorientation and reduced clarity at transit gate.

security.patrolAlert: Monitor transit pedestrian volume during peak dusk hours (7 PM - 9 PM).

property.contractorTask: Rewire driver ballast and secure mounting bracket.

reports.title: Severely Cracked & Displaced Pedestrian Pavement
reports.figureCaption: Severely fractured concrete path with exposed rubble and deep fissures
reports.description: The concrete pedestrian pathway at the Garden Shortcut midpoint has severely cracked and broken apart, with exposed gravel and rubble. Poses acute trip hazard.

routeImpact.recommendation: Reroute strollers, wheelchairs, and night walkers to Route A.

resident.warningText: Major trip and fall hazard in dark garden shortcut.
resident.actionNeeded: Choose Route A (Main Avenue) after sunset.

security.patrolAlert: Check for resident falls or injuries along unlit garden path segment.

property.contractorTask: Excavate tree root intrusions and lay level interlocking pavers.

reports.title: Sunken Sidewalk Pavers & Erosion Hole
reports.figureCaption: Subsided paving tiles with uneven elevation drop exceeding 65mm
reports.description: Ground subsidence beneath sidewalk pavers creating an abrupt step drop. Could cause ankle sprains or damage to accessibility aids during rainy nights.

routeImpact.recommendation: Walk along inner kerb until leveling works are complete.

resident.warningText: Sunken pavement edge near North Avenue crossing.
resident.actionNeeded: Watch your step when crossing towards commercial fringe.

security.patrolAlert: Place temporary reflective cones around the depression.

property.contractorTask: Compact sub-base soil and reseal interlocking brick joints.

reports.title: Broken Kerbstone & Curb Ramp Discontinuity
reports.figureCaption: Chipped concrete kerb with exposed aggregate and broken accessibility slope
reports.description: Kerb ramp at entrance to residential inner courtyard is fractured, blocking smooth pram and wheelchair access from road level to elevated walkway.

routeImpact.recommendation: Use main pedestrian gate ramp 30m south.

security.patrolAlert: Ensure courtyard access gate remains unobstructed.

property.contractorTask: Recast cement ramp slope with non-slip finish.

reports.title: Dense Tree Branches Obstructing Sightline
reports.figureCaption: Dense overhanging tree branches encroaching across the roadside walkway
reports.description: Heavy tree branches and overgrown shrubs hanging low over walkway, obscuring visibility around blind bend near lamp L-06. Conceals potential blindspots.

routeImpact.recommendation: Avoid traversing this section alone under low-light conditions.

resident.warningText: Blind curve with thick shrubbery concealing oncoming walkers.
resident.actionNeeded: Utilize personal torchlight or choose Route A.

security.patrolAlert: Designated high-risk ambush blindspot. Increased patrol frequency.

property.contractorTask: Prune overhang to 2.5m clearance and trim side bushes.

reports.title: Dense Hedge Encroachment Across Footpath
reports.figureCaption: Overgrown roadside shrubs narrowing available walking width to under 0.8m
reports.description: Untrimmed landscaping hedges narrowing the walkway corridor. Requires pedestrians to squeeze past vegetation or step onto adjacent turf.

routeImpact.recommendation: Minor narrowing of walkway; passable with caution.

resident.warningText: Narrowed footpath corridor along courtyard inner path.
resident.actionNeeded: Step carefully if ground is wet.

security.patrolAlert: Clear view of duress checkpoint at L-07.

property.contractorTask: Routine landscape maintenance and hedge trimming.
